segments.name: Financial and taxation
segments.description: Provides financial and taxation solution, education support, software and maintenance, and pre-IPO advisory services.
segments.evidence: The Company has determined that there is only one reportable operating segment.

revenueModel.text: Customers pay for financial and taxation solution, education support, software and maintenance, and pre-IPO advisory services.
revenueModel.evidence: Contract liability is recorded when a payment is received from a customer before the Company transfers the related services.

changes.text: In 2025, the Company sold Lichen Education, its education services subsidiary, to a third party.
changes.evidence: Upon the closing of the transaction on March 31, 2025, Mrs. Lina Li became the sole shareholder of Lichen Education and as a result, assumed all assets and liabilities of Lichen Education owned.
